name: blog-taxonomy
description: Suggest tags and categories for a blog post from its content, audit a site's tag and category health, and, only after the user approves a shown plan, sync tags and categories to WordPress, Shopify, Ghost, Strapi, or Sanity. suggest and audit are read-only; sync is dry-run by default and never deletes, merges, or edits post content. Use when the user says "tag suggestions", "taxonomy audit", "sync tags", "WordPress tags", "Shopify tags". Not for keyword research (blog-brief) or schema markup (blog-schema).
